discovery_method: WebSearch (standard mode, 1 query, primacy-bias lookup) plus WebFetch of arXiv abstract and HTML pages. No extended-mode search was used.
discovery_limits: Only one web search was issued. Most sources were chosen from prior knowledge of the literature and then fetched by URL; the fetch tool returns model-written summaries, not verbatim text. Section-level claims are therefore tool-mediated and should be checked against the PDF before quoting numbers.
